## Checklist (Definition of Done, CLAUDE.md)

- [ ] Spec with acceptance criteria exists and is linked
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered by tests
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy` and `pytest --cov` pass (CI)
- [ ] Data dictionary updated for new or changed tables
- [ ] New assumptions in `config/` with source and in `docs/methodology.md`
- [ ] ADR for larger decisions; `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
